findings.area: App shell > learning settings load (all pages, both roles)
findings.title: A failed GET /api/profile is invisible: no role=alert, and the learner's saved Reduce motion preference is silently not applied
findings.evidence: Scratch dir r10-C/t18.mjs, screenshot r10-C/t18-student.png. With reduceMotion=true stored for the student and GET /api/profile answered 500 on the dashboard: alerts=0, document.documentElement.dataset.reduceMotion is undefined, document.getAnimations().length=6 (animations running), console shows two 'Failed to load resource ... 500'. Same for the teacher (alerts=0). The error only surfaces if the user later opens Learning settings.
findings.repro: cd r10-C && node t18.mjs (sets reduceMotion on the R10 tester from journey-R10_Tester.json, injects 500 on GET /api/profile, opens the dashboard).
findings.expected: A visible role=alert (with Retry) when the preference cannot be loaded, or an explicit non-blocking notice; never a silent fallback to 'motion on' for a user who stored 'reduce'.
findings.actual: Dashboard and every other page render normally with no alert; the accessibility preference is dropped. By the literal rubric (4xx/5xx without visible alert) this is a P0 silent_error; filed P1 because no data is wrong and a reload recovers.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/app.tsx:147 and 150-152: the useLoad(loadSettings) result is only used on success. Render a dismissible role=alert with Retry (settings.reload) in Shell when settings.state.phase === 'error'.

findings.area: Guest recovery notice vs guest switch (R9-C-02 only partly fixed)
findings.title: Wrong-role expiry notice still leaks onto the new session when a 401 arrives while a guest switch is in flight
findings.evidence: r10-C/t20.mjs, screenshot r10-C/t20-race.png. Student clicks Lab map (GET /labs answered 401 after 800 ms) and 100 ms later clicks 'Faculty guest' (POST /auth/demo delayed 2 s). The switch completes (role=teacher, h1 'Class intelligence', faculty nav) but the faculty page shows 'Your guest session expired, so a new guest session was opened. Unsaved progress on the previous one is not shown here.' (the STUDENT wording).
findings.expected: A notice about the old student session must not appear on the faculty session (and vice versa).
findings.actual: The click-time setNotice('') in switchGuest runs before the late 401; onUnauthorized then sets the student notice, and the switch finishing does not clear it. Real trigger: a token that expires while the user switches guest.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/app.tsx:78-95 (onUnauthorized) and 44-66 (enterGuest): ignore the 401 handler while entering.current is true, and/or call setNotice('') on a successful enterGuest triggered by a switch (or key the notice by the role it describes).

findings.title: Activating Dismiss on a notice or error banner drops keyboard focus to <body>
findings.evidence: r10-C/t24.mjs: after Tab/focus on 'Dismiss' in the 'Your guest session expired' notice and Enter, document.activeElement is BODY. Same element pattern for the error banner (shell.tsx role=alert Dismiss).
findings.expected: Focus moves to a sensible target (the page heading or the main landmark) when the focused control is removed.
findings.actual: Focus is lost; a keyboard user has to tab again from the top of the page.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/shell.tsx:236-237: on dismiss call mainRef.current?.focus() (or reuse focusHeadingWhenReady) after clearNotice/clearError.

findings.title: A failed GET /api/rules is silent (console 503, no alert); hint cost copy silently degrades
findings.evidence: r10-C/t19.mjs, screenshot r10-C/t19-rules503.png. With 503 on /rules the open mission shows 0 alerts and the generic text 'Each hint carries an XP penalty set by the server.'; console has two 503 errors. No plausible default number is invented (good), but there is no visible error or Retry.
findings.expected: A non-blocking role=status/alert note that the scoring rules could not be loaded, with a way to retry.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/mission.tsx:59 and 299: when rules.state.phase === 'error' render a small role=alert with a Retry button calling rules.reload.
